params.title: My details
params.description: Your own record. To change your address or bank account, add a request under My change requests. An address change applies at once; a bank account change waits for HR.
params.note: people-record-change-approval (2026-09-29): REQ-ECR-003. The Employee list scoped by the base filter nextcloudUserId = @me, so an employee only ever sees their own row (and OpenRegister RBAC still decides what they may read). No create: the record is HR's; a change goes through EmployeeChangeRequest on MijnWijzigingsverzoeken.

params.title: Change requests
params.description: Changes to employee records. Open one to see the current and the proposed values side by side. Add one to ask for a change of your own address or bank account; your record is filled in for you.
params.note: people-record-change-approval (2026-09-29): REQ-ECR-001. The approval queue; ChangeApproverRoleGuard decides who may approve or reject each one. My HR > My change requests is a menu preset on this page (userId = @me), not a second index (ADR-097 Decision 5); its create form is the self-service request: employeeId is not required, ChangeRequestService fills it from the requester's own account, merges the flat address and bank fields into changes, and applies an address change at once (approver none, own record).

params.title: Change request
params.note: people-record-change-approval (2026-09-29): REQ-ECR-001. The data widget shows previousValues (Current values) next to changes (Proposed values); every stamped field is read-only because ChangeRequestService fills it. lifecycleActions mirror the schema: goedkeuren and afwijzen, both guarded by ChangeApproverRoleGuard; a rejection needs rejectionReason (refused otherwise).

params.title: Change approval rules
params.description: Who approves each kind of change to an employee record. A field covered by a rule with an approver can only change through a change request.
params.note: people-record-change-approval (2026-09-29): D2. Administered data, not code: the five seeded rules (adres none, bankrekening hr, persoonsgegevens hr, salaris accountant, contractvoorwaarden hr) apply to every administration without rules of its own.

params.title: Change approval rule
params.note: people-record-change-approval (2026-09-29): D2. A plain configuration record, no lifecycle.
